text:
maria_marketing: Quick sync — planning to announce Model Serving 2.1 next Wed 10:00 PT. Marketing needs final changelog, canonical docs link, a 1-paragraph benchmark blurb for the webinar, and confirmation of the rollout window. Can eng confirm any feature flags or early-access buckets?

kevin_eng: On it. Changelog draft ready locally — main headlines: smarter batching (lower p50) and KV cache bugfix. I’ll push PR and link here by EOD.

tess_docs: I can stage the release notes once we have the PR link and commit hash. Need a one-liner hero summary for the top of the page.

jordan_gm: For the webinar we want 2–3 benchmark slides: p50/p95 latency improvement and cost-per-token delta. Ravi, can you sketch the narrative?

ravi_prod: Yep. Suggest highlighting real-time chat latency and embedding throughput. I’ll draft a short narrative: problem -> what changed -> observed impact (numbers). Which test harness should we reference?

kevin_eng: Use the standard bench-suite on dedicated infra (bench-suite v2). We’ll run nightly tonight and expect numbers by 06:00 PT tomorrow. Note: there’s a DB migration on canary at 09:00 PT that might skew some metrics — I’ll call it out if it affects results.

maria_marketing: Good call, if the migration affects numbers we’ll add an explicit canary caveat in the blurb. Also: lead routing — will marketing tag inbound demo requests with `release-2-1-webinar`? Sales requested early access invites for high ARR leads.

jordan_gm: Use tag `release-2-1-webinar` and auto-route to SDR queue; for early access create an `early_access` cohort flag. Need a list of account IDs from sales to pre-seed the flag.

kevin_eng: We can enable `early_access` per account via the feature flags service. Default OFF, but can be ON for paid orgs. If sales gives the IDs we’ll flip them ahead of launch.

tess_docs: Release notes skeleton I’m using: Highlights, Changelog (PR links), Migration notes, Known issues, Benchmarks, Links (docs, webinar). I’ll insert the benchmark blurb and hero one-liner once you approve.

maria_marketing: Proposed timeline: EOD today — changelog PR link. Tomorrow 06:00 PT — benchmark numbers + 1-paragraph blurb. Tomorrow 12:00 PT — docs URL + release notes staged. Tomorrow 15:00 PT — final webinar copy to Jordan. Wed 10:00 PT — announce + email/webinar invites. Any blockers?

kevin_eng: Confirming schedule. Potential blocker: flaky CI test that might delay canary by ~6 hrs if it fails. I’ll post status to #eng-ci and ping here.

ravi_prod: No blockers from product. I’ll draft webinar narrative + CTA for landing page and post by tomorrow 3pm PT.

jordan_gm: I’ll set up landing page and routing. Need final webinar copy by tomorrow 3pm PT to wire up invites.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-24T09:00:00-07:00 — awaiting approval.

kevin_eng: Approving canary now, monitoring hooks ON. Will ping once metrics are green.

maria_marketing: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I’ll prepare email/press templates and leave placeholders for PR link, docs URL, and numbers. Ping this thread when PR is posted so I can swap links in the templates.

maria_marketing: Quick checklist I’ll follow up with in the morning: 1) PR link posted, 2) Bench numbers attached, 3) Docs staging URL, 4) Webinar copy in drive, 5) Routing test completed. Let me know if I missed anything.
